aboutText: Highrise Carpentry has been a cornerstone of Flemington's commercial construction scene for over 35 years. Based in Melbourne, we specialise in serving Tier 1 and major commercial builders across Victoria with large-scale carpentry needs. Our dedicated leadership and extensive team of highly skilled carpenters provide scalable workforce capability, ensuring reliable performance and consistent quality from project inception through to completion. We understand the demands of strict programmes, safety compliance, and quality assurance standards, making us a trusted partner for high-profile projects.
servicesText: We provide end-to-end carpentry solutions for commercial builders, including structural formwork, framing, cladding, and internal joinery. Our expertise ensures precision and compliance with industry standards, supporting projects from initial setup through to final touches.

services.title: Formwork & Shoring
services.desc: We provide robust formwork systems for concrete structures, ensuring safety and accuracy for large-scale commercial builds.

services.title: Structural Framing
services.desc: Our team delivers precise structural framing for multi-storey projects, using quality materials and skilled craftsmanship.

services.title: External Cladding
services.desc: We install durable external cladding that enhances building aesthetics and meets environmental standards.

services.title: Internal Joinery
services.desc: Highrise Carpentry offers custom internal joinery solutions, from office fitouts to commercial interiors.

services.title: Finishing Carpentry
services.desc: Our finishing services include trims, fixtures, and detailed woodwork to complete your project to perfection.

services.title: Project Management
services.desc: We offer consultation and management services to integrate carpentry seamlessly into your construction programme.
